summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.22/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.22 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 23, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 8¢ higher than a week ago, 8¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.49 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($3.96) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.49).
